items.label: win
items.note: decodeRecord unmarshals every line into map[string]any and type-asserts fields out of it. Decoding into a typed struct drops the map inserts and interface boxing.

items.label: win
items.note: aggregate re-sorts the whole group after every append. Sorting each group once after grouping removes nearly all of it.

items.label: win
items.note: renderRow formats each row with fmt.Sprintf and string concatenation. Appending into one reused buffer with strconv removes the formatting and most of concatstrings.

items.label: win
items.note: groupKey builds a map key with fmt.Sprintf per transaction. A struct key of account and currency removes it.

items.label: trap
items.note: Decompression is the largest entry and unavoidable: the feed's compression is fixed, the standard library is the only decompressor in scope, and on 1 vCPU overlapping it with parsing gains nothing. Ranking by raw share alone puts it first.
